- Hosted POC within your VPC via our Private deployment so inference happens in your network (no customer data leaves their environment).
- A pilot config: 2-week proof-of-value, preconfigured pipeline for retrieval + rerank + answer generation, plus token-level cost and latency dashboards for the pilot.

Proposed next steps:
1) If you agree, we’ll send a 1-page mutual action plan (attached) with timeline and goals.
2) Technical deep-dive (30 min) with your infra lead to confirm VPC connectivity and auth options.
3) Procurement touch to surface security docs (I’ve attached discovery_notes.pdf and a draft MAP).

Can you confirm if the above aligns with what you heard today? A quick reply with “Yes — send MAP” or “Needs change” is perfect. If it’s easier, happy to set a 15-min call to align.
